# macro.resonant_optical_depth { #clerq.macro.resonant_optical_depth }

```python
macro.resonant_optical_depth(number_density, length, wavelength, factor=1.0)
```

Resonant intensity optical depth ``N sigma_0 L`` of a cold, weak-field medium.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                               | Default    |
|----------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| number_density | float  | Atoms per cm^3.                                           | _required_ |
| length         | float  | Medium length, in cm.                                     | _required_ |
| wavelength     | float  | Transition wavelength, in nm.                             | _required_ |
| factor         | float  | Dipole moment squared relative to the cycling transition. | `1.0`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                               |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | The optical depth ``OD``; intensity transmission is ``exp(-OD)``. Doppler |
|        | float  | broadening reduces the peak.                                              |
